title: PYCT 21: Cloze Test - 2

subject: english

questions.question: This was enough ___________ the book store-owner-turned librarian
questions.solution: The use of ‘to assess its valuable content’ given in the second part of the sentence contains the hint. This supports the fact that it too much for the owner to assess its valuable contents. Therefore, the word ‘for’ makes the most appropriate option.

questions.question: painters __________ technical knowledge to paint
questions.solution: Clearly, the word ‘painters’ is in the plural form. Therefore, ‘has’ cannot be used. ‘Painters has had’ is also incorrect for the same reason. ‘Painters to have technical knowledge to paint’ makes an incomplete statement. We use ‘have’ with plural form of a noun, therefore, making option 3 as the correct choice.

questions.question: to understand nature, ______________ they fail to create a masterpiece
questions.solution: The former part of the sentence shows that painters lack the technical knowledge, therefore, something comes as a result to that. The word ‘hence’ is the only word from the given options that conveys the result of lack of technical knowledge leading to failure to create a masterpiece.

questions.question: All I ______________ in my life is about books and from books.
questions.solution: In the sentence, the narrator mentions of ‘his/her life’, which represents the past. From the given options, the only option that fits the blank correctly is ‘learned’.

questions.question: The grand library ___________ the palace is a cache of knowledge.
questions.solution: The sentence clearly shows that two locations have been connected. Therefore, we need to select a word that connects the two location, i.e. grand library and palace. The use of ‘to’ and ‘off’, therefore, do not fit. The grand library from the palace is also incorrect, because the grand library doesn’t come out of the palace. The use of the word ‘at’ makes the best fit and gives the sentence as: *The grand library at the palace is a cache of knowledge.*

questions.question: The _____ of energy in India are met from both commercial
questions.solution: With the word ‘met’ some need or requirement needs to be fulfilled, therefore, the correct word for the blank is ‘requirements’.

questions.question: and non commercial sources. The most _____ sources of energy today are coal and natural gas
questions.solution: Out of the given words, the most meaningful words to fill with ‘sources of energy’ would be ‘vital’ and ‘important’. ‘Important’ makes a better fit as we can hardly have any vital sources of energy.

questions.question: On the other hand, firewood, cow-dung cakes and vegetable waste etc. _____ non commercial forms of energy.
questions.solution: Constitutes means making or forming, which makes the sentence apt. On the other hand, the mentioned sources of energy cannot combine, mix or collaborate to form non-commercial forms of energy because ‘combine’ and mix’ would mean absolute merging, which is impossible, while ‘collaborates’ is only used for the living forms.

questions.question: While non commercial forms of energy _____ demand,
questions.solution: ‘Need the demand’, ‘shed the demand’ and ‘rests the demand’ make no meaning with reference to the given sentence. The appropriate word here is ‘meet’ as the demand is ‘met’.

questions.question: coal is the _____ source of commercial energy in India.
questions.solution: In India, coal is the widest used source of energy, therefore, from the given words in the options, ‘smallest’, ‘heaviest’ and hardest’ get ruled out. The appropriate fit is ‘largest’.
